name: Four Photo Reveal
summary: Build an editable four-photo reveal with original Images, independent framing, decoration, and optional CC0 music.

compatibility.selects: Needs the editor's existing original Image placement service plus public effects and motion graphics. Image Draft creation and export were verified in Selects Staging; exact reference-format fidelity remains provisional. The Node-free panel (2026-10-01) passed its local tests but has not yet been run in the app. Windows (2026-10-02): the music is found through the host FileSystem, with no shell command; a Windows pass on the Staging build is pending.
